headline: Public hearings on developments at 256 and 262 Sunderland Road, 1 and 3 Suburban Road, and 20-22 Goldthwaite Road.
summary: Site plan reviews are listed for ten properties, including 29 Firglade Street and 70 Summerhill Avenue. Several public hearings cover special permits for parking relief and more than one building on a lot.
